note: macOS-generated golden vectors for the OnlyCue MTC scheduling layer (MTCSchedule). The C# OnlyCue.Core re-implementation must reproduce every case exactly. batchChain is the load-bearing op: concat(windows) must equal combined, so a message dropped at a tiled seam and one duplicated there fail differently. hostTicksPerSecond() is out of contract — it is Mach-specific. To regenerate after a deliberate change, delete golden/mtc-schedule-v1.json and re-run the suite.
